verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is a cloud service that handles customer video and chat data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training data use, opt-out controls, or data-usage policies. The llms.txt probe concerns AI access to documentation, not customer data use, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
